func (AcceptanceOutcome) Known() bool

var AdmissionGuarantees
var AcceptanceErrorCodes
var ResourceActions
type RequestIdentity struct
  Key string
  HistoryEpoch string
  Attempt int64
type Submission struct
  Identity RequestIdentity
  Kind string
  Spec []byte
  RequiredGuarantees []string
  Label string
type Receipt struct
  Identity RequestIdentity
  LogicalOwner string
  OperationID string
  AcceptedGuarantees []string
  HistoryRetentionMs int64
type AcceptanceResult struct
  Outcome AcceptanceOutcome
  Receipt *Receipt
  Reason string
type HistoryWindow struct
  LogicalOwner string
  HistoryEpoch string
  MinimumRetentionMs int64
  ResultRetentionMs int64
type CancellationResult struct
  Outcome CancellationOutcome
type WorkProgress struct
  Done int64
  Total int64
type WorkFailure struct
  Classification FailureClass
  Message string
  Cause FailureCause
type OperationSnapshot struct
  Receipt Receipt
  State WorkState
  Progress WorkProgress
  CancellationRequested bool
  Failure *WorkFailure
  Label string
  LabelDerived bool
  Waiting string
type ObservationResult struct
  Outcome ObservationOutcome
  Snapshot *OperationSnapshot
type ResultChunk struct
  Receipt Receipt
  Offset int64
  Total int64
  Data []byte
  EOF bool
type ResultRead struct
  Outcome ResultOutcome
  Chunk *ResultChunk
type InventoryPage struct
  Outcome InventoryOutcome
  Snapshots []OperationSnapshot
  Next string
  Complete bool
type OperatorCancellation struct
  Outcome OperatorCancellationOutcome
func Encode(v *AcceptanceResult) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*AcceptanceResult, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type RecoverableAcceptance interface
  GetHistoryWindow() (HistoryWindow, error)
  Submit(submission Submission) (AcceptanceResult, error)
  Reconcile(identity RequestIdentity) (AcceptanceResult, error)
  CancelWork(identity RequestIdentity) (CancellationResult, error)
type RecoverableAcceptanceTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type RecoverableAcceptanceClient struct
func NewRecoverableAcceptanceClient(t RecoverableAcceptanceTransport) *RecoverableAcceptanceClient
type RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher struct
  Handler RecoverableAcceptance
func (RecoverableAcceptanceClient) GetHistoryWindow() (result HistoryWindow, err error)
func (RecoverableAcceptanceClient) Submit(submission Submission) (result AcceptanceResult, err error)
func (RecoverableAcceptanceClient) Reconcile(identity RequestIdentity) (result AcceptanceResult, err error)
func (RecoverableAcceptanceClient) CancelWork(identity RequestIdentity) (result CancellationResult, err error)
func (RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type OperationControl interface
  ObserveWork(identity RequestIdentity) (ObservationResult, error)
  ReadResult(identity RequestIdentity, offset, maxBytes int64) (ResultRead, error)
type OperationControlTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type OperationControlClient struct
func NewOperationControlClient(t OperationControlTransport) *OperationControlClient
type OperationControlDispatcher struct
  Handler OperationControl
func (OperationControlClient) ObserveWork(identity RequestIdentity) (result ObservationResult, err error)
func (OperationControlClient) ReadResult(identity RequestIdentity, offset, maxBytes int64) (result ResultRead, err error)
func (OperationControlDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (OperationControlDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (OperationControlDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (OperationControlDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
